mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_ID, USER_ID, USER_NM, MESSAGE, REGIST_DT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE ORDER BY REGIST_DT DESC, MESSAGE_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (MESSAGE_ID, USER_ID, USER_NM, MESSAGE, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{message}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
